# P11 Owning team reply

- Requirement: Required when writing an actual reply. Do not prefill in the initial request
- Placement: The relevant discussion in the body
- Narrative role: Updates current understanding and remaining questions with the new answer.
- Author: Owner of the area being asked about
- Reviewer: The actual owner who can confirm code, operational or policy facts in that area
- Check: Does the reply answer the question directly and separate confirmed scope, unknowns and constraints in its own area? Does it avoid requiring tracking IDs or past documents to answer?

<!-- body:start -->
## Owning team’s answer and remaining questions

**[Main question being answered].** [Answer]. We confirmed [applicable conditions and exceptions] using [the method performed, such as code inspection, an actual request or operational confirmation]. If actual material exists, attach an endnote to the relevant sentence.

We assess [what the request anticipated] as [confirmed, revised, rejected or requiring investigation]. [Newly confirmed constraint] has [impact on the required result]. Delete this paragraph if the request contains no hypothesis.

[Unconfirmed matters, additional consumers or policies] remain. Once [the area to confirm them] answers, we will [next action]. Questions may be linked by title or section number. Use tracking IDs only when exchanges about multiple items become complex.
